abstract_and_section_claims.note: Read the entire 16-page main manuscript and compared the abstract/results statements with Tables 1-2; visually inspected pages 9-13. The effect range is 0 to -0.00905 nats (the legacy paired_CE key also includes mean BCE), maximum official-metric change is 0.65 percentage points, expected serial overhead is 15-33%, and assurance overhead is 118-135%. Exploration is 9,600-32,000 trajectories and qualification is 1.4-2.3 GPU-hours. Positive feedback-vs-plan-once improvements 0.0065 and 0.0096 store rounded magnitudes of the signed -0.00649 and -0.00962 contrasts on page 9, rather than distinct experiments. Exchange-rate range 3.5-7.3 millinats rounds Table 2 values; qualification share 0.18 is an aggregate derived from S41/S15. The manuscript reports six evaluated controlled arms but expressly discloses Peptides confirmation failure and three representative-selection discrepancies on page 9; those qualifications are retained. Matching source statements does not verify observation-level evidence.

Page 9 and S12c require the full candidate ledger to establish the Roman/Pascal/COCO MPC-RH selections; Peptides Holm P=0.070 exceeds 0.05 and its registered lifecycle returns qC. The record preserves both evaluated-arm observations and lifecycle_resolution, without treating the radius arm as a confirmed final policy.
